own_site_finding: CRITICAL RESEARCH FINDING (overrides the pre-build has_own_site:false assumption). While pulling the GlossGenius service menu, the MOBILE BLOOD DRAW service description instructs clients to email lab orders to ashley@precisionskinwellnesslab.com, a business-name-matching custom domain. Checked that domain directly: https://precisionskinwellnesslab.com/ resolves (HTTP 200, no redirect to a parking broker) on Squarespace infrastructure, under her own root domain (not a *.squarespace.com or other platform subdomain). Per PIPELINE.md Fase 1 point 2 ('CHECK CRITICO DE WEBSITE PROPIO, leccion MaRe': probar el dominio del email) and the discovery rule that Squarespace/Wix/Webflow/etc. custom domains COUNT as an owned website (unlike glossgenius.com, square.site, Booksy, which do not), this business already owns and controls a domain purpose-built for this exact business name. The GlossGenius payload itself (`website_url`) is null and does not advertise it anywhere public (not on Google Maps, not linked from the booking page, not on any directory found), which is why the earlier automated verification missed it. The live page at that domain currently shows only Squarespace's default 'Coming Soon / We're under construction' placeholder with zero content (no services, no address, no booking) - so the owned domain is real but currently unbuilt.
has_own_site_reason_for_skip: Per PIPELINE.md, require_no_website discovery must exclude any business with an owned domain (platform subdomains like glossgenius.com/square.site are the only exception). An owned, business-matched custom domain exists here even though it is content-empty, so this candidate does not qualify for the has_own_site:false ('we built you a free sample site, you don't have one') cold-outreach angle this task was scoped for. Flagging as skip_has_own_site rather than building a demo whose core pitch ('you have no website') would be factually false.
hours_note: Not confirmed in research pulled before the skip decision; omit rather than invent.

reviewSamples.author: Tia Thorpe
reviewSamples.text: I had an amazing experience! The atmosphere was so serene and relaxing from the moment I walked in. Ashley was incredibly sweet, welcoming, and made me feel comfortable throughout the entire appointment. The Brazilian wax was done with great care and was much less painful than I expected. She was professional, gentle, and efficient. I highly recommend Ashley if you're looking for a great waxing experience. I'll definitely be back!

reviewSamples.author: Tiffany Griffin
reviewSamples.text: I went to visit Ashley today for a Brazilian! I hadn't had one in few years and decided to treat myself. Ashley was amazing made me feel super comfortable about everything! She did a great job and took her time. The office is super clean and very inviting! I highly recommend for any of your needs, if I could rate 10 stars I would!! Thanks Ashley!

reviewSamples.author: Andrea Hill
reviewSamples.text: I had a wonderful experience with Ashley. Her space is clean and inviting. Although I haven't had a wax in a while, she made me feel very comfortable and at ease. Will highly recommend her to anyone needing waxing and facial services!!

reviewSamples.author: Bristol Larson
reviewSamples.text: Ashley was incredible! I scheduled her mobile phlebotomy services after I had multiple failed lab draw attempts. She communicated well, showed up on time and got my draw completed on her first attempt! I was so impressed and would highly recommend her to anyone!

reviewSamples.author: Julia B
reviewSamples.text: Absolutely wonderful! This was my first facial but I knew I was in good hands!! Ashley is extremely knowledgeable, highly skilled and can help guide or answer any questions. Her office is calm and welcoming. She gave me professional recommendations with different options to suite my needs! Highly recommend
